    • getMouseEventSources

      protected void getMouseEventSources(LinkedList nodePath, int numObjectsToSkip, LinkedList<LgEventSource> eventSources, Class mouseEventClass)
      Search the objects in the node path for the given node for event sources that can generate specified mouse events. First find out the index to the highest node whose mouse event is disable by searching from the root to the leaf. Then searches to the root from the node one above the one pointed by the index.
